plugins.prepareCmd: test "$PACKED_VERSION" = '${nextRelease.version}' || { echo "::error::semantic-release computed ${nextRelease.version}, but the pack job packed '$PACKED_VERSION'." >&2; exit 1; }

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>
<% const packageIds = (env.RELEASE_PACKAGE_IDS || "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); if (packageIds.length) { %>
### NuGet packages

| Package | Version |
| --- | --- |
<% packageIds.forEach(function (id) { %>| `<%= id %>` | [<%= nextRelease.version %>](https://www.nuget.org/packages/<%= id %>/<%= nextRelease.version %>) |
<% }); %>
The `.nupkg` and `.snupkg` files attached to this release carry a signed build provenance attestation (`AdCodicem.ValueObjects.<%= nextRelease.version %>.sigstore.json`). To check one:

```sh
gh attestation verify AdCodicem.ValueObjects.<%= nextRelease.version %>.nupkg --repo AdCodicem/AdCodicem.ValueObjects
```
<% } %>
plugins.successComment:
:tada: This ${issue.pull_request ? 'PR is included' : 'issue has been resolved'} in version ${nextRelease.version} :tada:

The release is available on [GitHub release](https://github.com/AdCodicem/AdCodicem.ValueObjects/releases/tag/${nextRelease.gitTag})

Your **[semantic-release](https://github.com/semantic-release/semantic-release)** bot :package::rocket:
